datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mali to classify geographic areas into IPC acute food insecurity phases. Survey data were spatially compiled into GeoJSON format representing food insecurity classifications at three time points in 2019 (February, June, October), reflecting population-level impacts of food security crises.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought.
